Hi Alex / Priya -

Great to meet yesterday. Quick recap + proposed next steps to get the POC dataset and eval plan moving so we can hit your pilot goals.

Summary of success criteria (from conversation):
- Reduce incorrect triage responses by >= 30% on the pilot prompt set
- Median generation latency <= 350ms at 10 RPS
- No PII leakage in outputs (automated checks + manual review)

What we need from ACME for the dataset/eval:
1) Prompt set: representative prompts you want the model to handle (CSV or JSONL). Prefer columns: id, prompt_text, context (optional), expected_response (optional), priority_tag.
2) Logs / examples: actual historical system/user logs that reflect the distribution (PII should be pseudonymized - see notes below).
3) Baseline labels: if you have expected outputs or a pass/fail metric for sample prompts, include them for initial quality checks.

Suggested timeline:
- Aug 19: provide a ~200-1,000 prompt sample + 1-2k log examples (sample)
- Aug 18-20: 30-min handoff call to review format and redaction rules
- Aug 24: Redwood runs initial eval and shares first-pass metrics and examples by Aug 28

Ownership:
- ACME: provide prompt sample + redaction plan (Alex / Priya)
- Redwood: intake + initial eval (Marissa lead, Dev for ingestion, Rishi for eval metrics)

Data handling notes (short):
- Pseudonymize PII fields where possible. If you cannot pseudonymize, hash or replace with stable tokens (e.g., [USER_123]) and include a schema mapping.
- Preferred formats: CSV or JSONL (newline-delimited JSON). Zip files are fine for large exports.

I attached a small template (poc_prompt_template.csv) to illustrate the preferred columns. Can you confirm you can provide a sample by EOD Wed Aug 19? Also propose a 30-min handoff slot on Tue Aug 18 between 9-12 PT - what works?

Thanks - looking forward to progressing this.

-

Hi Alex - quick technical notes for the upload so your engineering/security team can prep: 

Required schema (recommended):
- id (string) - stable id for traceability
- prompt_text (string) - user/system prompt
- context (string, optional) - any prior turns or system state
- expected_response (string, optional) - if you have a target output
- label (string, optional) - pass/fail or category

Formats accepted: CSV or JSONL (newline-delimited JSON).
- Max recommended file size per upload: 500MB (we can accept larger but prefer chunking).
- Please avoid embedded binary fields; include references to attachments if necessary.

PII handling: pseudonymize or hash (SHA256) fields containing PHI/PII. Use stable tokens so evaluation can track same entities across records.

Upload options & instructions:
- SFTP endpoint: sftp.redwoodinference.com (will open a scoped account).
- S3 presigned: we can generate an expiring presigned URL upon request.
- Encryption: AES-256 zip with a separate password over secure channel is acceptable.

Attached is a short upload_instructions.pdf with example curl commands and sample JSONL lines. If you can tell me expected sample size, I can provision temporary storage and send credentials before Tue.

Thanks - Dev
